name: DebugFlags_Run
evidence: Unreferenced 'DEBUG MODE' screen (String_DebugFlags_Help: up/down choose, left/right cursor, A change, Start BIT<->DEC, Sel/B end): edits the sign-up debug flag at SRAM 1:$B0BF; no caller found, never executed

name: DebugFlags_Loop
evidence: Per-frame loop: 00:0956, 00:044B, Joypad_UpdateIdleFrames (7D:7BA4)/7BC1, call JoypadDispatch with Table_DebugFlags_Buttons

name: Table_DebugFlags_Buttons
evidence: JoypadDispatch inline table (5 words): A -> DebugFlags_OnA, B and Select -> DebugFlags_Exit, Start -> DebugFlags_OnStart, none -> DebugFlags_Idle

name: DebugFlags_Idle
evidence: No button: DebugFlags_PlaceCursor, DebugFlags_UpdateHoldTimer, D-pad with repeat (hJoyPressedRepeat & $F0) -> DebugFlags_HandleDpad

name: DebugFlags_OnA
evidence: A pressed ('Change'): BIT mode xors the selected bit (mask $8000>>wRam_C0D4) into the 16-bit value; DEC mode adds the place value 10^k of the selected digit with wrap; value written through WriteByteFar (48:4616) (SRAM bank 1)

name: DebugFlags_Exit
evidence: B/Select: slide window out (DebugFlags_SlideOut), fade out 4F:4370, then 4E:4795 and 68:49B6 (SRAM checksum refresh routines of banks 4E/68) and return

name: DebugFlags_OnStart
evidence: Start pressed ('BIT<->DEC'): cycles display mode wRam_C0D8 (1 = BIT, 2 = DEC) and re-places the cursor sprite / digit index wRam_C0D4

name: DebugFlags_EntryHasHighByte
evidence: Returns NZ when the second address word of entry wRam_C0E5 in Table_DebugFlags_Entries is non-zero (value has a high byte); duplicated at 19:43D7

name: DebugFlags_HandleDpad
evidence: Up/Down change entry wRam_C0E5, Left/Right move the digit/bit cursor wRam_C0D4 (0-4 in DEC mode, 0-15 in BIT mode)

name: DebugFlags_EntryHasHighByte2
evidence: Duplicate of DebugFlags_EntryHasHighByte

name: DebugFlags_LoadHelpText
evidence: Renders String_DebugFlags_Help (TextTiles_RenderGrid (48:40A9), text to tiles in WRAM bank 3) and a cursor glyph to VRAM $8800/$8C00/$9000 and $8000

name: String_DebugFlags_Help
evidence: Shift-JIS: '＝＝ ＤＥＢＵＧ ＭＯＤＥ ＝＝ / ↑↓：えらぶ ←→：カーソル Ａ：へんこう / Ｓｔａ：ＢＩＴ←→ＤＥＣ Ｓｅｌ／Ｂ：しゅうりょう' + rule (2-byte characters, 3 lines)

name: DebugFlags_DrawEntryName
evidence: Draws the title string of entry wRam_C0E5 (pointer table at $4912, e.g. '【サインアップデバッグフラグ】') into VRAM $9400 via TextTiles_RenderGrid (48:40A9), then DebugFlags_DrawValue

name: DebugFlags_DrawValue
evidence: Renders the value of the entry as full-width characters from String_DebugFlags_Chars: BIT mode 8/16 x '０/１', DEC mode a 5-digit decimal, otherwise hex; uploads the tiles to VRAM $9600

name: String_DebugFlags_Chars
evidence: Full-width digit glyphs '０'-'９','Ａ'-'Ｆ' (2 bytes each), 8 x '－' at $47CE (missing high byte) and the decimal template '【０００００】' at $47DE

name: DebugFlags_PlaceCursor
evidence: Moves the cursor sprite (WRAM bank 7, wSpriteSlots+17) to x = 8*cursor+$10 (BIT mode) or 8*cursor+$48 (DEC mode)

name: Table_DebugFlags_Objects
evidence: Object table (1 entry: frame table $4821, script $4828) of the cursor sprite, loaded with 00:0A82 (b=0, slot $DA10)

name: DebugFlags_SlideIn
evidence: Slides the window layer in: wRam_C0E5 goes $99 down to 0 in steps that shrink from $10 to 1, written to rWY each frame

name: DebugFlags_SlideOut
evidence: Slides the window layer out: wRam_C0E5 from 0 up to $99 written to rWY each frame (inverse of DebugFlags_SlideIn)

name: DebugFlags_UpdateHoldTimer
evidence: If hJoyHeld changed resets wRam_C0E7, else increments it (saturating): auto-repeat timer (4/16-bit steps after $3C frames)

name: DebugFlags_ReadValue
evidence: Reads the 16-bit value of the entry through ReadByteFar (00:1620) from SRAM bank 1: B = byte at second pointer (0 if none), C = byte at first pointer (Table_DebugFlags_Entries)

name: DebugFlags_WriteValue
evidence: Writes D to the second and E to the first pointer of the entry through WriteByteFar (48:4616) (SRAM bank 1); the inverse of DebugFlags_ReadValue

name: Table_DebugFlags_Entries
evidence: Entry table: entry 0 = (SRAM address $B0BF, second address 0), followed by the word $4914 at $4912 = title string pointer; only one entry (layout of the 6 bytes is HYPOTHESIS)

name: String_DebugFlags_Title
evidence: Shift-JIS '【サインアップデバッグフラグ】' = '[sign-up debug flag]', title of entry 0

name: Palette_DebugScreens
evidence: Palette block (8 x 4 colours) loaded to $D800 by Debug_ErrorScreenTest; identical to 1B:4000

name: Debug_ErrorScreenTest
evidence: Unreferenced debug screen: hex-edits three values (kind, number hi/lo) and on A calls the error screen 5C:5150 (used by bank 65 error handlers); text 'A: error, B+up/down: kind, Sel: END, up/down (left/right): number'; never executed

name: DebugErrorTest_Loop
evidence: Per-frame loop: 00:044B, Joypad_UpdateIdleFrames (7D:7BA4)/7BC1, call JoypadDispatch with Table_DebugErrorTest_Buttons

name: Table_DebugErrorTest_Buttons
evidence: JoypadDispatch inline table: A -> DebugErrorTest_OnA, B/Start ignored, Select -> DebugErrorTest_Exit, none -> DebugErrorTest_Idle

name: DebugErrorTest_Idle
evidence: DebugErrorTest_UpdateHoldTimer then D-pad handling DebugErrorTest_HandleDpad (hJoyPressedRepeat), loop

name: DebugErrorTest_OnA
evidence: A pressed: fade out (4F:4370), calls the error screen CommErr_ShowScreen (5C:5150) with A=wRam_C0D4 (kind), H=wRam_C0D6, L=wRam_C0E5 (number), restores the edited values and re-enters the screen

name: DebugErrorTest_Exit
evidence: Select pressed: fade out 4F:4370 and return A=1

name: DebugErrorTest_HandleDpad
evidence: Up/Down change wRam_C0D6 (or wRam_C0D4 while B is held), Left/Right change wRam_C0E5 (by 4 after the hold timer passes $3C); redraws via DebugErrorTest_DrawValues

name: DebugErrorTest_LoadHelpText
evidence: Renders String_DebugErrorTest_Help (TextTiles_RenderGrid (48:40A9)) into VRAM $8800/$8C00

name: String_DebugErrorTest_Help
evidence: Shift-JIS 'Ａ：エラー Ｂ＋↑↓：しゅるい Ｓｅｌ：ＥＮＤ / ↑↓（←→）：Ｎｕｍｂｅｒ' = A: error, B+up/down: kind, Sel: END, up/down (left/right): number

name: DebugErrorTest_DrawValues
evidence: Draws '【' + six full-width hex digits (wRam_C0D4, C0D6, C0E5) + '】' from Data_DebugErrorTest_HexChars and uploads to VRAM $8E00

name: Data_DebugErrorTest_HexChars
evidence: 16 full-width characters '０'-'９','Ａ'-'Ｆ' (2 bytes each) indexed by nibble at six sites in DebugErrorTest_DrawValues

name: DebugErrorTest_UpdateHoldTimer
evidence: Same auto-repeat hold timer as DebugFlags_UpdateHoldTimer (wRam_C0E7/C0E8 with hJoyHeld)
